Experiment 1
Using a measuring cylinder, 30 cm of hydrochloric acid was poured into a polystyrene cup.
The temperature of the hydrochloric acid was measured.
2 g of solid D was added to the hydrochloric acid and the mixture stirred with a thermometer.
The temperature reached by the liquid mixture was measured.
Observations were recorded.
Observation: Rapid effervescence.
The polystyrene cup was emptied and rinsed with distilled water.

Burnable Ice (Methane Hydrate)
Methane hydrate is ice which contains trapped methane gas. Methane is released when the ice
melts and is a useful fuel.
Plan an investigation to find the volume of methane gas trapped in 1 kg of this ice.
You are provided with a lump of the ice weighing between 100 g and 200 g and common laboratory
apparatus.
You may include a diagram in your answer.
